blurb: Bentwater Golf Club is proud to announce the transition of our Club to a new management firm - Club Specialists, Intl. (CSI) effective May 1, 2021. CSI has consulted with over 500 private clubs, golf courses, resorts and real estate developments. The principles of CSI bring more than 100 years of collective operating experience in private club operations, private club development, marketing, membership development
